purpose: Separately measure and calibrate static spatial density/presentation pressure without mixing moving-subject or transit-route-deviation evidence into the dynamic spatial contract.

separationRule.prohibition: Static and dynamic calibration rows, ranges, receipts, and promotion decisions MUST NOT be pooled or substituted for one another.

dimensions.definition: Source-backed static map candidates admitted by enabled non-moving layers plus rendered place candidates.
Static business/place labels actually rendered after zoom and density admission.
Enabled non-moving map layers participating in the observation.
Cesium camera height defining the spatial scale/zoom regime for this static observation.
Measured P95 rendered-frame duration over the local observation window.

observationWindow.rule: 16 consecutive complete observations under one app version, device/runtime profile, viewport regime and static-layer identity.

calibration.promotionRule: Candidate calibration requires live traces spanning at least two device profiles and all three viewport regimes. Numeric Formula execution remains blocked until Creator review explicitly promotes a calibration artifact.

prohibitions: Do not include moving-subject count, bus route deviation, aircraft motion, vessel motion, or other dynamic-state dimensions in this contract.
Do not use dynamic-contract calibration ranges for this contract.
Do not materialize all-world POIs in browser memory to increase candidate counts.
Do not convert missing evidence to zero except rendered_static_label_count where an observed zero is valid.
Do not execute Formula before separate static calibration and ablation pass.
reason: Static-spatial observations require their own ranges because camera scale, static candidate density and label admission are not statistically interchangeable with moving-subject and route-deviation pressure.
